description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping class, testing its creation from array data and attribute value extraction from LDAP entries.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMappingTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping, testing creation and attribute extraction functionalities.

methods.name: testCreateFromArray
methods.description: Tests creation of LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping object from an array and validates the toArray output and attribute names retrieval.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayWithInvalidField
methods.description: Checks that an InvalidArgumentException is thrown when an invalid field is supplied during creation.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayWithEmptyField
methods.description: Ensures exception handling for missing 'field' key in the input array.

methods.name: testCreateFromArrayWithEmptyAttributeName
methods.description: Checks that an exception is thrown when 'attributeName' is missing in the input array.

methods.name: testExtractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Validates extraction of attribute values from LDAP entries into search filter parameters.

methods.name: testExtractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParamWithoutMapping
methods.description: Tests behavior when no attribute mappings are provided, expecting a null result.
